The user wants to know which colored point on the faucet corresponds to the lever used to turn it on. Looking at the image, the faucet has a spout and a handle mechanism. The yellow point is on the vertical part of the spout. The red point is on the top of the handle/lever. The orange point is on the bottom of the handle. The blue point is on the side of the handle base.

Typically, to operate a single-lever faucet, you grab the lever on top, which is the red point. The red dot is positioned on the top surface of the handle where a finger would naturally press to lift and turn it. The orange is lower, possibly on the body. The blue is on the side. The yellow is on the spout itself, not the handle.

So the correct grasp point to turn it on is the red point, which is on the lever handle.

Thus the answer is D.
